SettingsLocked: settings.json could not be opened; another program may be using it. AutoTrigger started without your settings and will not save any change until it is restarted.
SettingsUnreadable: settings.json could not be read, nor set aside. AutoTrigger started without your settings and will not save any change until it is restarted.
SettingsSetAside: settings.json could not be read and was set aside ({file}). AutoTrigger started with empty settings.
ImportReplaceText: Replace your applications, profiles and displays with the ones from AutoActions? A copy of your current settings is kept.
ImportNotJson: this file is not valid JSON ({detail})
ImportNotAutoActions: this file does not look like AutoActions settings (UserSettings.json)
ImportQuitAutoActions: AutoActions is still running: quit it so that actions do not run twice.
ImportAutoStart: AutoActions starts with Windows: turn that off in AutoActions, and turn on Start with Windows here.
ImportProfileNewId: Profile '{name}' had no valid id; it was given a new one.
ImportProfileSameId: Profile '{name}' has the same id as another profile; skipped.
ImportAppNoPath: Application '{name}' has no program path; skipped.
ImportAppStore: Application '{name}' is a Microsoft Store app; imported by its program, {path}.
ImportAppNoProfile: Application '{name}': its profile no longer exists; imported without a profile.
ImportShortcutsSkipped: AutoActions shortcuts not imported: {count}. In AutoTrigger, keyboard shortcuts belong to profiles.
ImportRunNoProgram: Profile '{profile}': a 'Run program' action has no program.
ImportUnknownType: Profile '{profile}': action type '{type}' is not known; kept as an unknown action, which does nothing.
ImportUnknownDepth: Profile '{profile}': unknown color depth ({depth}); left out.
ImportBadResolution: Profile '{profile}': resolution '{text}' cannot be read; left out.
IssueApplicationProfile: Application '{name}' is assigned to a profile that does not exist.
IssueDisplay: Profile '{profile}' ({event}): display action for a display that is no longer in the list.
